experience 0 square metres of production space 0 completed projects 0 MORE THAN WELDING Base Group is an exceptional company because it is made up of exceptional people. Each and every day is an opportunity for us to understand our customer’s business, our role in their supply chain, and, finally, to provide the customer with the solution they are looking for. We specialize in High-Mix Low-Volume manufacturing. We offer production of equipment and high-quality welded constructions for industry. We support our customers from the very first stages of designing industrial equipment by selecting the most optimal technological solutions. As a result, together, we develop long-term business relationships and create mutual growth in international markets. In every situation, we act in accordance with the win-win principle based on trust. As a manufacturer of industrial equipment, we provide ourselves and our customers with space to comfortably improve crucial processes. Integrated project delivery From initial technical arrangements to final execution, we approach each project as a coordinated manufacturing process tailored to the customer’s requirements. Our organisation combines production expertise, process supervision and practical engineering support to ensure efficient implementation of industrial equipment and welded structures as a reliable metal fabrication company . This allows us to manage demanding orders in a structured way, while maintaining quality , technical consistency and delivery reliability throughout all stages of project execution. We also adapt our manufacturing methods and workflow planning to the specific complexity, scale and technical assumptions of each order, including metal fabrication , cutting , assembly and final finish requirements. As a result, we are able to support both custom projects and repeatable production programmes within demanding industrial supply chains across a wide variety of industries . Career development in an industrial environment At Base Group, we create conditions for professional growth through clearly defined career paths, practical skills development and participation in technically advanced projects. We believe that employee development is closely linked to the quality of our organisation, which is why we support competence building across engineering, manufacturing and operational roles in house and in cooperation with the wider industrial environment. Working at Base Group means becoming part of a production environment where commitment, responsibility and the willingness to develop are recognised and given real opportunities to grow. Employees have the opportunity to gain experience in projects carried out for demanding industrial sectors and international customers, including projects involving stainless steel, metal structures, industrial equipment , laser technologies and advanced production methods. We place strong emphasis on knowledge transfer, cooperation between departments and continuous improvement of practical qualifications.
